reviews.text: Nice moisturising serum, can't say much more as of now.
reviews.zh: 唔錯嘅保濕精華，目前嚟講冇咩其他可以講。

reviews.text: I like that this is very minimal ingredients.
reviews.zh: 我鍾意佢嘅成分好簡單。

reviews.text: Absolutely loved it helped with my acne scars and blemishes so much !
reviews.zh: 真心超級鍾意，對我嘅暗瘡印同瑕疵幫助超大！

reviews.text: I really like this brand! This serum feels nice and has a good texture, I have sensitve, oily skin and it is not too heavy and good for morning skincare!
reviews.zh: 我真係好鍾意呢個品牌！呢支精華嘅觸感好好，質地亦唔錯，我係敏感肌同油性肌，用落唔會太厚重，適合早上護膚用！

reviews.text: Soothing and moisturizing, I use after I apply toner. I love snail mucin and have yet to see hype the additional rice ingredient makes a difference
reviews.zh: 舒緩又保濕，我喺塗完爽膚水之後用。我鍾意蝸牛黏液，但暫時仲未見到宣傳中額外加入嘅米成分有咩明顯分別。

reviews.text: I love this essence! It absorbs quickly, hydrates deeply, and makes my skin feel smoother and more balanced. My skin looks healthier and more glowy with regular use. A great addition to my routine.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意呢支精華！吸收得好快，深層保濕，用完皮膚感覺更柔滑、更平衡。持續用皮膚睇落更健康更有水光。係我日常護膚程序嘅一個好幫手。

reviews.text: This is very soft and easy to apply. It absorbs into the skin very quickly and feels very hydrating
reviews.zh: 呢個好柔軟，易於塗抹。吸收到皮膚嘅速度好快，感覺非常保濕。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
